MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA 🚦

Asahan ang mabigat na daloy ng trapiko sa mga sumusunod na kalsada sa September 7, 10, at 14, 2025, mula 2:00AM - 7:00AM at 2:00PM - 7:00PM, upang bigyang-daan ang isasagawang 2025 Bar Examinations na gaganapin sa New Era University (NEU) sa kahabaan ng Central Avenue, Quezon City:

• Commonwealth Ave. papasok ng Central Ave.
• Visayas Ave. papasok ng Central Ave.

Samantala, mananatili namang bukas ang iba pang kalsada para sa regular na daloy ng trapiko, ngunit mahigpit na ipapatupad ang NO PARKING sa kahabaan ng Central Avenue.

Mahigpit ding ipinagbabawal ang SALUBONG, PANINIGARILYO, at MAGUGULO/MAIINGAY NA AKTIBIDAD sa kahabaan ng Central Avenue.

Magtutulungan at nakaantabay ang mga tauhan ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) at Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS) para maisaayos ang daloy ng trapiko sa nasabing lugar.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.

PROBLEMA SA BAHA

Hinimok ni Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Sec. Vince Dizon ang Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) at mga lokal na pamahalaan na patuloy na makipagtulungan sa pagresolba sa problema sa baha sa Metro Manila.

Sa pagdinig ng House appropriations committee sa DPWH budget, iginiit ni Dizon na kailangan din ng ahensya ng suporta mula sa pribadong sektor.

“Napakaganda po na ang private sector mismo ay nag-o-offer na tumulong sa pag-manage ng baha sa NCR,” saad niya.

𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂 𝐀𝐃𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐎𝐑𝐘
The Department of Public Works and Highways - North Manila District Engineering Office (DPWH-NMDEO) will begin the rehabilitation and major repair of Dimasalang Bridge starting at 11 p.m. on September 13.

The scope of work includes retrofitting of piers and abutments, replacement of girders from concrete to steel, and complete redecking of the slab.

According to DPWH-NMDEO, the southbound lanes of  Dimasalang Bridge will be the first to undergo rehabilitation, while the northbound lanes will remain open to traffic. The tentative completion date will be on December 15.

Motorists are advised to take alternate routes as traffic buildup is expected during the rehabilitation period.

A protest outside the House of Representatives in Quezon City escalated on Friday as members of progressive groups and flood victims clashed with police. 

Demonstrators hurled paint and mud at authorities while denouncing alleged irregularities in the Department of Public Works and Highways’ flood control projects. 

The rally coincided with lawmakers’ deliberations on the DPWH budget, with protesters demanding accountability and transparency in the agency’s spending.
